title: VietIRRStructuredTableRecord
description: Schema for structured extracted table data with cell matrices and semantic dimensions.

table_id.description: Unique canonical identifier for the table region (TAB_...).

bbox.description: Bounding box coordinates [x1, y1, x2, y2] on the page.

caption.description: Table title or caption if present.

rows.description: Array of table row data arrays.

cells.description: Structured cell metadata records with row, col, content, and cell evidence IDs.

normalized_representation.description: Markdown or linearized representation for LLM ingestion.

semantic_dimensions.description: Domain attributes (reservoirs, water levels, dates, flow rates, capacities).
